The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
The Lord is King; he is clothed with glory; the Lord is clothed with strength; power is the cord of his robe; the world is fixed, so that it may not be moved.
耶和華作王！他以威嚴為衣穿上；耶和華以能力為衣，以能力束腰，世界就堅定，不得動搖。
Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
The seat of your power has been from the past; you are eternal.
你的寶座從太初立定；你從亙古就有。
The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
The rivers send up, O Lord, the rivers send up their voices; they send them up with a loud cry.
耶和華啊，大水揚起，大水發聲，波浪澎湃。
Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.
The Lord in heaven is stronger than the noise of great waters, yes, he is stronger than the great waves of the sea.
耶和華在高處大有能力，勝過諸水的響聲，洋海的大浪。
Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
Your witness is most certain; it is right for your house to be holy, O Lord, for ever.
耶和華啊，你的法度最的確；你的殿永稱為聖，是合宜的。
